inputs.skill_update: A valid legacy Skill field update. Updating an active skill appends a new immutable version instead of mutating a historical version.
inputs.promotion: skill_id, retained version, and a non-empty evaluation evidence object with a stable evidence_id.
inputs.rollback: skill_id, retained target version, and a non-empty reason. Rollback selects a prior retained version without deleting history.
inputs.run_pin: run_id, skill_id, and a retained version. Existing pins are immutable.

outputs.active_skill: Legacy get, list, search, export, and statistics return only the current active skill projection.
outputs.history: Version rows preserve the full serialized Skill content and their creation time. Each skill version is immutable once recorded.
outputs.promotion: A successful promotion switches only the active-version selector and retains the evidence object and promotion timestamp.
outputs.run_pin: Recorded-run pins continue to resolve their originally pinned version after promotion or rollback.

errors: Promotion rejects missing, empty, or evidence_id-free evaluation evidence.
Promotion, rollback, or pinning rejects a missing skill or missing retained version.
A run_id cannot be repinned to another skill version.
Historical version updates and deletes are not exposed by the active-skill API.

compatibility.legacy_rows: Existing skills migrate to one retained version matching their existing version and become the active selection.
compatibility.legacy_api: Existing add, get, list, search, update, merge, delete, upsert, export, and statistics call shapes remain available against the active projection.
compatibility.history: Delete removes the active projection but retained versions and immutable recorded-run pins remain queryable by the governance API.
compatibility.rollback: Rollback changes only active selection and leaves all retained version rows and run pins unchanged.
